properties.description: List of Customer ID and the number of accounts held per product

content.query:
WITH DEP AS
(
    SELECT ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT AAS_ACID) AS DEP_ACCOUNTS_CNT
    FROM eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
    WHERE AAS_AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(AAS_AS_OF_DATE) FROM eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER)
        AND AAS_DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
        AND AAS_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
        AND (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL)
        AND AAS_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    GROUP BY ORGKEY
)
---, LNS AS 
---(
---    SELECT ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(AAS_ACID) AS LNS_ACCOUNTS_CNT
---    FROM eds.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
---    WHERE AAS_AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) FROM eds.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER)
---        AND AAS_DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
---        AND AAS_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
---        AND GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
---        AND LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL
---    GROUP BY ORGKEY
---)
, LNS AS 
(
    SELECT CUST.ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT AAS.ACID) AS LNS_ACCOUNTS_CNT
    FROM (SELECT * FROM eds.LOAN_FACT WHERE AS_OF_DATE IN (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) FROM eds.LOAN_FACT)) AS LF 
        INNER JOIN eds.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN AS AAS
            ON LF.GAM_ACID = AAS.ACID
            AND LF.GAM_BANK_ID = AAS.BANK_ID
            ---AND LF.AS_OF_DATE = AAS.AS_OF_DATE
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM eds.CUSTOMER_DIM WHERE SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31') AS CUST
            ON AAS.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
            AND AAS.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
            ---AND AAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
    WHERE ---AAS.AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) FROM eds.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN)
        ---AND 
        AAS.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
        AND AAS.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND ((LF.ACCT_CLS_FLG <> 'Y') OR (LF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' AND LF.ACCT_CLS_DATE > LF.AS_OF_DATE))
        AND LF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    GROUP BY ORGKEY
)
, CCD AS 
(
    SELECT CUST.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ACC.CRDACCT_NBR) AS CCD_ACCOUNTS_CNT
    FROM (SELECT * FROM eds.CCD_CUSTOMER WHERE SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31') CUST
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM eds.CCD_ACCOUNTS WHERE  CRDACCT_STATUS <> 8 AND AS_OF_DATE IN (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) FROM eds.CCD_ACCOUNTS)) ACC
            ON CUST.CUST_NBR = ACC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
    GROUP BY CUST_CIF_NBR
)
, TRU AS
(
    SELECT CUST.UNIQUE_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO) AS TRU_ACCOUNTS_CNT
    FROM busc.TRU_CUST AS CUST
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_BASELINK AS BASE
            ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
            AND BASE.ISLATEST = 1 AND BASE.ISACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO AS PORT
            ON BASE.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND PORT.ISLATEST = 1 AND PORT.ISACTIVE = 1
    WHERE CUST.ISACTIVE = 1 AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1
        AND PORT.STATUS = 'A'
    GROUP BY CUST.UNIQUE_ID
)
, TRY AS
(
    SELECT [value] AS CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS TRY_ACCOUNTS_CNT
    FROM (
        SELECT * FROM BUSC.TRY_LEGALENTITY
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(External_Ref, '|')
        WHERE ISACTIVE = 1 AND ISLATEST = 1
            AND STATUS = 'ENABLED'
        ) A
    GROUP BY [value]
)
SELECT ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID, DEP_ACCOUNTS_CNT, LNS_ACCOUNTS_CNT, CCD_ACCOUNTS_CNT, TRU_ACCOUNTS_CNT
FROM eds.CUSTOMER_DIM AS CUST
    INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL AS CTL
        ON CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
    LEFT JOIN DEP
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = DEP.CUSTOMER_ID
    LEFT JOIN LNS
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = LNS.CUSTOMER_ID
    LEFT JOIN CCD
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = CCD.CUSTOMER_ID
    LEFT JOIN TRU
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = TRU.CUSTOMER_ID
    LEFT JOIN TRY
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = TRY.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE CUST.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
